Pursuant to Article II, Section 1 of Republic Act No.
9054, the Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (ARM) shall be
composed of the following provinces and city:
Lanao del Sur
iii. Maguindanao
City of Marawi

The Department of the Interior and Local Government is
hereby directed to supervise the foregoing reorganization of the
administrative regions in Mindanao and publish the new composition of said
administrative regions.

All orders, rules, regulations and issuances, or parts
thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order, are hereby
repealed or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately upon
City of Manila, September 19, 2001.
